capabilities: Add folders to an icon list from plugin settings
Display a chosen icon before each configured folder name
Remove folders from the icon list
Store SVG icon files anywhere in the vault
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README gives no examples beyond pointing to the settings tab and SVG file placement.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows folders only by name, with no visual markers to distinguish them at a glance.
summary: Adds an icon in front of configured folder names in the file explorer.
